en: It's a microwave oven, plugged in and humming faintly.
text: E un cuptor cu microunde, în priză și bâzâind încet.

en: Will you let your Rotom go into the microwave oven?
text: Îl lași pe Rotom să intre în cuptorul cu microunde?

en: Rotom went into the microwave oven! Rotom learned Overheat!
text: Rotom a intrat în cuptorul cu microunde! Rotom a învățat Overheat!

en: Rotom went into the microwave oven! It wants to learn Overheat, but it knows four moves already.
Rotom didn't learn Overheat.
1, 2 and... poof! Rotom forgot {forgotten}.
And... Rotom learned Overheat!
That move can't be forgotten here. Rotom didn't learn Overheat.
Rotom is in the microwave oven already. Will you let it out?
Rotom came out of the microwave oven and went back to its own form!
